description: This file defines data models, request/response structures, enums, and constants for the OpenClaw Protocol Gateway module in Swift. It includes message framing, agent management, node interaction, session handling, configuration, and various operational parameters used in the protocol communication.

classes.name: ErrorCode
classes.description: Enumeration of possible error codes returned in protocol responses.

classes.name: ConnectParams
classes.description: Structure holding parameters for establishing a connection in the protocol.

classes.name: HelloOk
classes.description: Structure representing the handshake response from the server, containing server features and snapshot.

classes.name: RequestFrame
classes.description: Structure for request message framing with method and parameters.

classes.name: ResponseFrame
classes.description: Structure for responses with success or error payload.

classes.name: EventFrame
classes.description: Structure for event messages with event type and payload.

classes.name: PresenceEntry
classes.description: Represents a presence update for a node or device.

classes.name: Snapshot
classes.description: Represents a full system state snapshot, including presence entries, health, and version info.

classes.name: ErrorShape
classes.description: Structure for error details sent in responses.

classes.name: AgentEvent
classes.description: Represents an event emitted by an agent.

classes.name: AgentParams
classes.description: Parameters for sending agent messages, including attachments and context.

classes.name: AgentWaitParams
classes.description: Parameters for waiting on an agent run.

classes.name: NodePairRequestParams
classes.description: Parameters for requesting pairing with a node.

classes.name: NodePairListParams
classes.description: Parameters for listing node pairing requests.

classes.name: NodePairApproveParams
classes.description: Parameters to approve a node pairing request.

classes.name: NodePairRejectParams
classes.description: Parameters to reject a node pairing request.

classes.name: NodePairVerifyParams
classes.description: Parameters to verify a pairing with a token.

classes.name: NodeInvokeParams
classes.description: Parameters for invoking a node command.

classes.name: NodeInvokeRequestEvent
classes.description: Event structure for invoking a node request.

classes.name: SessionsMessagesSubscribeParams
classes.description: Parameters to subscribe to session messages.

classes.name: SessionsMessagesUnsubscribeParams
classes.description: Parameters to unsubscribe from session messages.

classes.name: ConfigSchemaLookupParams
classes.description: Parameters to lookup schema at a specific path.

classes.name: ConfigSchemaLookupResult
classes.description: Result of schema lookup including children and hints.

classes.name: WizardStartParams
classes.description: Parameters to start a wizard session.

classes.name: WizardNextParams
classes.description: Parameters for progressing to next wizard step.

classes.name: WizardCancelParams
classes.description: Parameters to cancel a wizard session.

classes.name: TalkSpeakResult
classes.description: Results of speech synthesis including audio data.

classes.name: ChannelsLogoutParams
classes.description: Parameters to logout of a channel.

classes.name: WebLoginWaitParams
classes.description: Parameters for waiting on web login.

classes.name: AgentsFilesGetParams
classes.description: Parameters to get a specific agent file.

classes.name: AgentsFilesGetResult
classes.description: Result of getting an agent file.

classes.name: AgentsFilesSetParams
classes.description: Parameters to set/update an agent file.

classes.name: AgentsFilesSetResult
classes.description: Result of setting an agent file.

classes.name: ModelChoice
classes.description: Data model for selecting a machine learning model.
